statistics.name: Total records
statistics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total records" FROM records

statistics.name: Average rating
statistics.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TRY_CAST("Rating" AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS "Average rating" FROM records

statistics.name: Count by release year
statistics.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST("Release Year" AS INTEGER) AS "Release year", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM records GROUP BY "Release year" ORDER BY "Release year"

definition.name: Rated records
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Rated records" FROM records WHERE TRY_CAST("Rating" AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL

definition.name: Records with comments
definition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "With comments" FROM records WHERE COALESCE("Comments", '') <> ''

definition.name: Highest rating
definition.sql: SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST("Rating" AS DOUBLE)) AS "Highest rating" FROM records
